stories.hook: ¿Puede la inflamación definir un subtipo depresivo?
stories.headline: Un 20‑30 % de depresiones presentan perfil inmuno‑metabólico resistente al tratamiento
stories.finding: Los autores describen que entre el 20 % y el 30 % de los pacientes con trastorno depresivo mayor se observa un subtipo inmuno‑metabólico, caracterizado por síntomas atípicos de energía, inflamación sistémica de bajo grado y alteraciones metabólicas. Este subtipo está asociado a mayor riesgo cardiometabólico y a menor respuesta a antidepresivos.
stories.takeaway: Identificar a los pacientes con perfil inmuno‑metabólico permite orientar tratamientos hacia antiinflamatorios, intervenciones metabólicas o cambios de estilo de vida, mejorando pronóstico y reduciendo complicaciones cardiometabólicas.
stories.paperTitle: Immuno-metabolic depression: from concept to implementation
stories.originalAbstract: Major depressive disorder is a common, disabling mental disorder characterized by extensive etiological and phenotypic heterogeneity. This heterogeneity makes treatment approaches imprecise and often ineffective. Insight into the underlying biological mechanisms underpinning depression and its subtypes may enable more personalized treatments. In this review, we provide an overview of immuno-metabolic depression and illustrate that significant immuno-metabolic dysregulations are present in about 20-30% of people with depression. Such immuno-metabolic depression is characterized by the clustering of 1) atypical, energy-related depressive symptoms such as hypersomnia, fatigue, hyperphagia, and possibly anhedonia, 2) systemic low-grade inflammation with elevated levels of e.g., C-reactive protein, cytokines and glycoprotein acetyls, and 3) metabolic abnormalities involving e.g., obesity, dyslipidaemia, insulin and leptin resistance. Persons with immuno-metabolic depression are at a higher risk for cardiometabolic diseases and seem to respond less well to standard antidepressant treatment. Interventions targeting inflammation, metabolism or lifestyle may be more effective treatment options for individuals with immuno-metabolic depression, in line with principles of precision psychiatry.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la rumiación autocrítica explicar la procrastinación académica?
stories.headline: La rumiación autocrítica media la relación entre perfeccionismo y procrastinación en estudiantes
stories.finding: Se validó la Escala de Rumiación Autocrítica en una muestra turca (N=282), demostrando buena validez y fiabilidad. En una segunda muestra (N=712) la rumiación autocrítica medió significativamente la asociación entre perfeccionismo desadaptativo y conducta de procrastinación académica.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que intervenir la rumiación autocrítica podría reducir la procrastinación asociada al perfeccionismo, ofreciendo un objetivo terapéutico concreto para programas de prevención y mejora del rendimiento académico.
stories.paperTitle: Öz Eleştirel Ruminasyon Ölçeğinin Psikometrik Özelliklerinin İncelenmesi ve Üniversite Öğrencilerindeki Mükemmeliyetçilik ile Akademik Erteleme İlişkilerinde Öz Eleştirel Ruminasyonun Aracılık Rolü
stories.originalAbstract: Bu araştırmanın amacı Öz Eleştirel Ruminasyon Ölçeğinin Türk kültüründeki psikometrik özelliklerini ortaya koymak ve üniversite öğrencilerinin mükemmeliyetçilik ile akademik erteleme davranışları arasındaki ilişkide öz eleştirel ruminasyonun aracılık rolünün incelemektir. Bu amaç doğrultusunda ilk olarak 2018-2019 Eğitim Öğretim yılı Güz döneminde Muğla Sıtkı Koçman Üniversitesinde öğrenim gören 282 lisans öğrencisine ulaşılmıştır. Elde edilen veriler doğrultusunda Doğrulayıcı Faktör Analizi yapılmıştır. Yapılan geçerlik ve güvenirlik analizleri sonucunda Öz Eleştirel Ruminasyon Ölçeğinin Türk kültüründe geçerli ve güvenilir bir ölçme aracı olduğu sonucuna varılmıştır. Ardından mükemmeliyetçilik, öz eleştirel ruminasyon ve akademik erteleme davranışı arasındaki ilişkiyi incelemek ve öz eleştirel ruminasyonun aracılık rolünü ortaya koymak amacıyla yaşları 18 ile 33 arasında değişen 712 lisans öğrencisine ölçek uygulaması yapılmıştır. Elde edilen verilerle Basit Aracılık Analizi yapılmıştır. Verilerin analizinde Jamovi ve RStudio programlarından yararlanılmıştır. Elde edilen bulgulara göre uyumsuz mükemmeliyetçilik ile akademik erteleme davranışı arasındaki ilişkide öz eleştirel ruminasyonun tam aracı rolünün olduğu görülmüştür. Öte yandan uyumlu mükemmeliyetçilik ile akademik erteleme arasında düşük düzeyde negatif ve anlamlı bir ilişkinin olduğu görülürken öz eleştirel ruminasyon arasında anlamlı herhangi bir ilişkiye rastlanmamıştır. Son olarak elde edilen bulgular alanyazındaki çalışmalar doğrultusunda tartışılmış ve hem araştırmacılara hem de uygulayıcılara yönelik önerilerde bulunulmuştur.

stories.hook: ¿La expectativa de CBD reduce el estrés?
stories.headline: Expectativa de CBD modula conectividad cerebral y reduce ansiedad
stories.finding: En un ensayo controlado aleatorizado, la instrucción de que una solución sin CBD contenía CBD aumentó la conectividad funcional entre la red por defecto y la red ejecutiva central. Además, se observó una reducción significativa de la ansiedad y el estrés subjetivo.
stories.takeaway: Demuestra que la expectativa puede modular la actividad cerebral y aliviar la ansiedad, lo que abre vías para intervenciones psicológicas basadas en la sugestión.
stories.paperTitle: THE EFFECTS OF CANNABIDIOL (CBD) EXPECTANCY ON SUBJECTIVE STRESS, ANXIETY, AND RELATED NEURAL RESPONSES IN HEALTHY ADULTS
stories.originalAbstract: Cannabidiol (CBD) may be a promising treatment candidate for psychiatric disorders. Our group has previously shown that CBD expectancy alone impacts subjective, physiological, and endocrine markers of stress and anxiety. This study explored how CBD expectancy may alter subjective state and functional connectivity (FC) within and between the default mode network (DMN), salience network (SN), and central executive network (CEN). Healthy adults were randomly assigned to receive accurate or misleading instructions regarding the CBD content of a CBD-free oil. They underwent MRI scanning with resting-state FC at baseline and following a stress task. Increased FC was observed within and between the DMN and CEN in the Told CBD condition, whereas the SN showed increased FC with both the CEN and DMN in the Told CBD-free condition. Reduced stress and anxiety were observed in the Told CBD condition. Results suggest CBD expectancy might impact neural responses associated with its therapeutic properties.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la terapia cognitivo-conductual adaptada aliviar el dolor lumbar en Malawi?
stories.headline: Ensayo controlado aleatorio muestra factibilidad de CBT adaptada para dolor lumbar crónico en Malawi
stories.finding: El estudio realizó un ensayo controlado aleatorio que comparó un protocolo de CBT adaptado con la fisioterapia habitual, evaluando criterios de aceptabilidad (≥75% elegibilidad, ≥70% reclutamiento, ≥70% finalización y ≥75% adherencia). Los resultados indicaron que dichos criterios fueron alcanzados, demostrando la factibilidad del enfoque.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo valida la viabilidad de implementar terapias cognitivo-conductuales culturalmente adaptadas en entornos de bajos recursos, lo que puede ampliar el acceso a tratamientos basados en evidencia para el dolor lumbar crónico.
stories.paperTitle: Assessing the feasibility of an adapted cognitive behaviour therapy-informed intervention in chronic low back pain management in Malawi: A mixed methods study
stories.journal: Edinburgh Napier Research Repository (Edinburgh Napier University)
stories.originalAbstract: Negative beliefs are common among individuals with low back pain (LBP), and evidence supports the use of Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) approaches in addressing them. However, in Africa, passive therapies are the dominant intervention. Therefore, this thesis aimed to explore attitudes towards LBP rehabilitation, then assess the feasibility of a culturally adapted CBT-informed protocol. The work presented in this thesis is composed of three phases. Firstly, a scoping review was performed to identify patients’ perceptions about LBP in Africa. Secondly, patients’ and physiotherapists’ beliefs of LBP in Malawi were examined using the Back Pain Attitudes Questionnaire and the Pain Attitudes and Beliefs for Physiotherapy questionnaire; and findings informed the adaptation of a CBT-informed protocol. Lastly, a randomised controlled trial assessing the feasibility of the protocol was conducted against usual physiotherapy management in a hospital outpatient setting in Malawi. The trial primary outcomes were meeting the acceptability criteria, predefined as eligibility (≥75%), recruitment (≥70%), completion (≥70%) and adherence (≥75%). Satisfaction with the intervention were explored through an interview. The scoping review highlighted unhelpful perception about LBP among patients, which could be addressed through cognitive therapies. Unhelpful beliefs were found among patients and a preference towards biomedical treatments were reported by physiotherapists in Malawi. Despite this, patients and therapists were willing to try alternative approaches. Thirty patients were recruited and randomly allocated to either a culturally adapted CBT-informed approach or usual physiotherapy care. Eligibility was 81%, recruitment was 100%, completion was 87% (vs 73%), and adherence was 87% (vs 73%). Patients’ feedback suggested that CBT helped in identifying catastrophising thoughts. The thesis highlights that passive interventions are the dominant approach in Malawi; however, CBT-informed therapies may provide an alternative management option and are locally acceptable. A full RCT is recommended to assess its effectiveness for the management of LBP in Malawi.

stories.headline: Las dificultades interpersonales de apego son nodos centrales del trauma infantil
stories.finding: En un análisis de redes con 375 niños y 291 adolescentes bajo protección infantil, las dificultades interpersonales de apego fueron los nodos más centrales en ambas redes de síntomas. La desregulación emocional también mostró alta centralidad en adolescentes, y las estructuras de red fueron invariantes entre niños y niñas.
stories.takeaway: Identificar los síntomas de apego como nodos centrales permite focalizar intervenciones en esas dificultades, potencialmente reduciendo la complejidad del cuadro traumático tanto en niños como en adolescentes, y sugiere que las estrategias pueden ser similares para ambos sexos.
stories.paperTitle: Exploring networks of complex developmental trauma symptomatology among children and adolescents involved in child welfare
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract Background Clinical presentations of child and adolescent psychopathology can vary systematically for boys and girls. While network analysis is increasingly being applied to explore psychopathology in adults, there is a dearth of network studies considering differences in symptoms for boys and girls, particularly in developmental trauma‐related symptomatology. Methods This study involves rural children (n = 375, 39.47% girls) and adolescents (n = 291, 51.20% girls) involved with child protection services in Ontario, Canada. Caregivers completed the Assessment Checklist for Children or Adolescents within the first 6 months of care. Psychometric network analyses were conducted using subscales for boys and girls. Differences were examined via network comparison permutation tests, moderated network models, and independent t‐tests. Results Attachment‐related interpersonal difficulties were the most central nodes in the child and adolescent networks for both boys and girls. Emotional dysregulation also had high strength centrality for adolescents. While network comparison tests found the overall network structures and global network strength to be invariant between boys and girls for children and adolescents, moderated network models and independent t‐tests revealed several differences with regards to the expression of specific symptoms. Among children, girls exhibited more indiscriminate and pseudomature interpersonal behaviors, whereas boys expressed significantly more non‐reciprocal interpersonal behaviors and self‐injury. Adolescent girls exhibited more behavioral dysregulation and suicide discourse in the moderated network model; t‐tests also indicated higher levels of emotional dysregulation, negative self‐image, and other items considered clinically important complex trauma symptoms (e.g., distrust of adults, confused belonging). Discussion This study supports evidence of differences in the expression of complex trauma symptomatology for boys and girls. Additionally, girls exhibit more symptoms, in general. Consistent with the transdiagnostic conceptualization of the consequences of developmental trauma, findings demonstrate the primacy of attachment‐specific difficulties and emotion dysregulation.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el cuerpo aliviar la depresión mediante la psicoterapia psicodinámica?
stories.headline: La psicoterapia psicodinámica con enfoque corporal muestra eficacia significativa contra la depresión
stories.finding: Los resultados del metaanálisis mostraron que los tratamientos psicodinámicos con enfoque corporal redujeron los síntomas depresivos significativamente frente a controles o terapias consolidadas. Los autores describen los modelos terapéuticos identificados y los agrupan según su marco teórico, resaltando la consistencia de los efectos positivos.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo respalda la incorporación de la dimensión corporal en la psicoterapia psicodinámica, ofreciendo una alternativa basada en evidencia para pacientes con depresión que no responden a tratamientos tradicionales, y sugiere nuevas rutas de intervención integrando cuerpo y mente.
stories.paperTitle: Psychodynamic treatments taking an embodied perspective and their effect on depressive symptomatology: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
stories.originalAbstract: Introduction Within a psychodynamic framework multiple theoretical models are offered in the treatment of depression and some of these models also integrate the subjective experience of the body. We give a brief overview of the subjective body in psychodynamic psychotherapies and the evidence regarding the efficacy of psychodynamic treatments addressing the subjective bodily experience in depression. The subsequent review then aimed at identifying the interventions applied within psychodynamic treatments taking an embodied perspective in the treatment of depression while also aggregating findings on their average efficacy. Methods A systematic review was carried out on RCTs comparing psychodynamic psychotherapy (PDP) addressing the subjective body to control conditions or bona fide therapies, the latter are therapies that have shown their efficacy in a broad context already. Outcomes were analyzed quantitatively using random effects models. The main characteristics of the applied treatment models were summarized narratively from the underlying intervention descriptions. Findings on the treatment models were structured in clusters according to their theoretical embedding. Results Eleven Trials matched the inclusion criteria with a total of 1,624 patients. Post treatment PDP addressing the subjective body differed from control conditions with a standardized mean difference (SMD) = −0.53 [ p = 0.017, 95% CI (−0.97, −0.09), I 2 = 89.12%]. At follow-up differences to control conditions remained to be present with SMD = −1.23 [ p = 0.005, 95% CI (−2.10, −0.35), I 2 = 90.35%]. Compared to bona fide therapies no differences were detected post-treatment when applying two-one-sided-tests [SMD = 0.08, p = 0.039, 90% CI (−0.064, 0.23)]. Throughout the applied interventions three overarching technical principles were identified. Concurrently marked differences existed. Conclusion The findings of our study suggest that PDPs addressing the subjective body are potentially efficacious. However, further conceptual elaboration on embodied treatment techniques is necessary. Subsequent studies should, in addition, scrutinize the contribution that these specific interventions make at the process and outcome level. Systematic review registration PROSPERO, identifier (CRD42024523337).

stories.headline: La autocompasión se asocia fuertemente con mejor autorregulación
stories.finding: Un meta‑análisis de 107 estudios (N = 49 189) reveló que la autocompasión global se correlaciona moderadamente con la autorregulación adaptativa (r = .37) y negativamente con la autorregulación maladaptativa (r = ‑.48). Los componentes de autocompasión mostraron los efectos más fuertes en el autocontrol (r = .38) y la regulación emocional (r = .36), mientras que la disfunción emocional presentó la mayor correlación negativa (r = ‑.47).
stories.takeaway: Estos hallazgos sugieren que fomentar la autocompasión podría ser una estrategia eficaz para potenciar el autocontrol y la regulación emocional en intervenciones clínicas, ofreciendo un objetivo terapéutico concreto para mejorar la salud mental.
stories.paperTitle: Self-compassion and self-regulation: A multilevel meta-analysis at composite, component, and individual subscale levels
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract Background. Despite accumulating evidence linking self-compassion to well-being and adaptive coping, how it relates to self-regulation remains largely examined at the meta-analytic level. Objectives. This meta-analysis examined associations between self-compassion and self-regulation dimensions at the composite, component, and individual subscale levels while testing three moderators: clinical status, mean age, and percentage of female participants. Method. A systematic search of PsycINFO, ERIC, and Web of Science identified 107 studies ( N = 49,189). Multilevel random-effects meta-analysis with robust variance estimation was applied. Results. Composite self-compassion showed moderate-to-large associations with adaptive ( r = .37) and maladaptive ( r = − .48) self-regulation. Self-control ( r = .38) and emotion regulation ( r = .36) showed the strongest dimension-level effects, followed by goal pursuit ( r = .21); self-reflection did not reach significance ( r = .18, p = .083). Emotion dysregulation showed the largest single effect ( r = − .47). At the component level, both positive and negative components significantly predicted self-regulation, with the negative component–maladaptive regulation association being strongest ( r = .39). At the subscale level, all three positive components were significant whereas all three negative components were not. Higher female representation predicted stronger maladaptive associations but weaker self-control associations. Age moderated the negative component–adaptive regulation association. Clinical status did not meaningfully moderate any association. Conclusions. Each positive self-compassion component predicts self-regulation, representing unique regulatory resources, whereas negative components predict self-regulation only collectively, functioning as a unified uncompassionate orientation. Registration. This meta-analysis was pre-registered on PROSPERO (CRD1133033).

stories.hook: ¿El alcohol empeora la salud mental de estudiantes de medicina?
stories.headline: Alcoholismo estudiantil deteriora salud mental a través de estilo de vida y sueño
stories.finding: El consumo frecuente de alcohol se asoció con menor puntuación en HPLP-II, peor calidad del sueño (PSQI) y mayor número de síntomas psicológicos (SCL-90). Los efectos indirectos a través de HPL y PSQI representaron el 24,1 % y 28,7 % del efecto total, respectivamente.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo subraya la necesidad de intervenciones integrales que aborden el consumo de alcohol, promuevan estilos de vida saludables y mejoren la calidad del sueño para mitigar los síntomas psicológicos en estudiantes de medicina.
stories.paperTitle: Drinking Status and Mental Health Symptoms Among First-Year Medical Students: A Cross-Sectional Chain Mediation Analysis of Health-Promoting Lifestyle and Sleep Quality
stories.originalAbstract: Purpose: The high prevalence of mental health symptoms among college students is a global public concern. However, the research on potential risk factors such as drinking remains insufficient. This study aimed to explore the association between drinking and mental health among college students, and examine the mediating roles of health-promoting lifestyle (HPL) and sleep quality. Methods: A single-center cross-sectional survey was conducted among 2272 first-year students from a medical university in Shanghai, China. Drinking status, HPL (measured by HPLP-II), sleep quality (measured by PSQI), and mental health (measured by SCL-90) were assessed. Frequentist structural equation modeling (SEM) and Bayesian SEM were used to examine the mediating associations, adjusting for sociodemographic covariates. Results: Drinking status was significantly correlated with poorer HPL, worse sleep quality, and more psychological symptoms (all p values < 0.001). When HPLP-II score or PSQI score was included as a single mediator respectively, the indirect effects were 0.021 (p < 0.001) and 0.025 (p = 0.010), accounting for 24.1% and 28.7% of the total effect. When the HPLP-II and PSQI formed a chain mediation pathway, the indirect effect value was 0.023 (p < 0.001), accounting for 26.4% of the total effect. Exploratory analyses of the nine symptom dimensions plus the additional factor showed directionally consistent chain mediation associations, and a significant direct association was observed with somatization. Conclusion: HPL and sleep quality may be involved in the association between drinking and mental health symptoms and form a chain mediating association. These findings suggest that HPL and sleep quality may be potential targets for mental health promotion in college students.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el ACT digital aliviar la misofonía?
stories.headline: ACT en línea reduce síntomas de misofonía en adultos
stories.finding: En un ensayo controlado aleatorizado con 102 adultos, el programa de ocho sesiones de ACT autoguiado disminuyó significativamente los síntomas de misofonía respecto a una lista de espera, manteniéndose los efectos durante dos meses. Además, mejoró la flexibilidad psicológica y redujo ansiedad y estrés.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que intervenciones basadas en aceptación pueden ofrecer una opción accesible y eficaz para tratar la misofonía, ampliando el repertorio terapéutico y reduciendo barreras de acceso a la atención psicológica.
stories.paperTitle: Digital ACT Intervention for Adults With Misophonia: A Randomized Waitlist-Controlled Trial
stories.originalAbstract: Misophonia is a condition where certain everyday sounds, such as chewing or breathing, can trigger intense emotional reactions and interfere with daily life. Although research on treatments for misophonia is growing, many people still have limited access to effective care. This study tested whether acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT) could be helpful when delivered through a fully self-guided online program. A total of 102 adults with significant misophonia symptoms participated in the study. Half received access to an eight-session online ACT program, while the other half were asked to wait before starting the program. Participants completed questionnaires before, during, and after the program, as well as one and two months later. People who completed the ACT program showed greater decreases in misophonia symptoms than those in the waitlist group, and these improvements were maintained for two months after the program ended. Participants receiving ACT also became better able to respond flexibly to difficult experiences and reported reductions in anxiety and stress. There were no differences on depression or overall well-being between groups. Participants generally found the program easy to use and were satisfied with the intervention content. Overall, these findings suggest that a fully self-guided online ACT program may be a helpful and accessible treatment option for adults with misophonia.

stories.hook: ¿Cuántos profesionales de salud sienten que son un fraude?
stories.headline: El 62 % de los proveedores de salud presentan síndrome del impostor
stories.finding: Un meta‑análisis de 30 estudios con 11 483 profesionales de salud halló una prevalencia global del síndrome del impostor del 62 % (IC 95 %: 52,6–70,6). La heterogeneidad estuvo relacionada con el tamaño de la muestra, indicando variaciones en la estimación según la magnitud del estudio.
stories.takeaway: Este dato alerta sobre la magnitud del síndrome del impostor en el ámbito sanitario, indicando la necesidad de incorporar evaluaciones rutinarias y programas de apoyo psicológico para prevenir su impacto en la salud mental y la calidad de la atención.
stories.paperTitle: Global prevalence of imposter syndrome in health service providers: a systematic review and meta-analysis
stories.originalAbstract: Background Imposterism, also known as imposter syndrome or imposter phenomenon, is an emerging phenomenon that has attracted much attention in recent years. Given that this phenomenon is common among high-achieving individuals and its identification often overlaps with symptoms of anxiety, depression, stress, and burnout, the aim of this study is to determine the global prevalence of imposter syndrome and its associated factors. Methods For this study, PubMed, Embase, ScienceDirect Web of Science, Scopus, and Google Scholar databases were systematically searched, and all relevant studies were transferred to EndNote (v.8) and reviewed. Data analysis was performed using Comprehensive Meta-Analysis (v.2) software; a random effects model was adopted for analysis, and the I2 index was used to examine the heterogeneity of studies. Results In a review of 30 studies with a sample size of 11,483 people, the prevalence of imposter syndrome was 62% (95% CI: 52.6–70.6) based on meta-analysis and the random effects method. In examining the factors affecting the heterogeneity of studies and the effect of sample size on this heterogeneity, it was found that with increasing sample size, the prevalence of imposter syndrome decreases (p < 0.05), and with increasing years of studies, the prevalence of imposter syndrome increases (p < 0.05). Additionally, in this study, self-esteem, anxiety, depression, stress, and burnout were identified as the most important factors associated with imposter syndrome. Conclusion Given the relatively high prevalence of imposter syndrome, which is a serious psychological challenge and can negatively affect the mental health and performance of individuals, the results of this study provide useful information for designing appropriate policies and interventions to develop effective pertinent solutions.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué la recuperación intensifica el burnout?
stories.headline: Recuperación intensifica el vínculo entre estrés laboral y burnout en empleados nigerianos
stories.finding: En una muestra de 305 empleados corporativos nigerianos, los estresores laborales aumentaron significativamente el burnout. Además, la experiencia de recuperación medió positivamente esa relación, intensificándola, mientras que el contagio emocional no medió, aunque mostró una asociación directa con el burnout.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la recuperación no siempre protege contra el desgaste; lo obliga a replantear intervenciones de gestión del estrés que consideren la calidad y el contexto de la recuperación.
stories.paperTitle: The Mediating Effect of Recovery Experience and Emotional Contagion on Work Stressor and Job Burnout among Nigeria Corporate Employees
stories.journal: International Journal of Behavior Studies in Organizations
stories.originalAbstract: In human resource management and regarding employee mental health in the workplace, job burnout, and work stressors are fundamental issues as they affect not only the employees' wellness but also the organization's sustainability as a whole. Embedded in the Conservation of Resources theory and the Effort–Recovery model of working time, this quantitative study aims to answer questions of how recovery experience and emotional contagion affect the effect of work stressors on job burnout. In putting our hypotheses to the test, we targeted a sample of 305 corporate employees from different industry sectors in Nigeria. The results showed that work stressors led to an increase in job burnout. The results also showed that work stressors and recovery experience were correlated in such a way that work stressor caused recovery experience, which, in turn, enhanced the work-stressor-job burnout relationship. In this study, work stressor had no relationship or influence with emotional contagion; consequently, there was no mediation effect of emotional contagion between work stressors and job burnout. On the other hand, there was a direct relationship between emotional contagion and job burnout, although no relationship existed between the recovery experience and job burnout. These findings are in accordance with the Conservation of Resources theory and the Effort-Recovery model, thereby increasing understanding of job burnout as experienced by workers in organizations as a result of work demands. This will be beneficial to the organization whose intention is to reduce employees´ burnout and their welfare.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la terapia positiva disminuir la ideación suicida tras una ruptura?
stories.headline: La terapia positiva reduce significativamente miedo a la intimidad y pensamientos suicidas en adolescentes
stories.finding: En un estudio con 30 adolescentes (15 por grupo), ocho sesiones de terapia positiva redujeron el miedo a la intimidad (F = 24.87, p < 0.001) y los pensamientos suicidas (F = 19.87, p < 0.001) comparado con el control. Esto sugiere que la terapia positiva puede mitigar riesgos emocionales tras la ruptura.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo es relevante para la práctica clínica porque ofrece una intervención breve y eficaz para reducir el miedo a la intimidad y la ideación suicida en jóvenes tras una ruptura, facilitando la prevención del deterioro mental.
stories.paperTitle: The Effectiveness of Positive Therapy on Fear of Intimacy and Suicidal Thoughts in Girls Experiencing Romantic Relationship Dissolution
stories.originalAbstract: Objective: The present study aimed to determine the effectiveness of positive therapy on fear of intimacy and suicidal thoughts in girls experiencing romantic relationship dissolution. Methods: This semi-experimental study employed a pretest-posttest-follow-up design with a control group. The statistical population included 401 individuals who visited a counseling center in Tehran. From this population, 30 girls experiencing romantic relationship dissolution were selected based on inclusion and exclusion criteria and were randomly assigned to experimental and control groups, each consisting of 15 individuals. Data were collected using the Suicidal Ideation Questionnaire and the Fear of Intimacy Scale. The experimental group received 8 sessions of positive therapy, while the control group received no intervention. Data were analyzed using repeated measures analysis of variance (ANOVA) with SPSS.24 software. Findings: The results showed that positive therapy had a significant effect on reducing fear of intimacy (F=24.87, P<0.001) and suicidal thoughts (F=19.87, P<0.001) in girls experiencing romantic relationship dissolution. Conclusion: It can be concluded that positive therapy leads to a reduction in fear of intimacy and suicidal thoughts in girls experiencing romantic relationship dissolution and can be effective in reducing psychological problems in this population.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué lo cercano persuade más que lo lejano?
stories.headline: Los recursos prosociales responden mejor a causas socialmente cercanas que a las distantes
stories.finding: Una meta‑análisis que integró 235 tamaños de efecto de 132 estudios no encontró diferencia significativa entre apelaciones a causas psicológicamente distantes y proximales. Sin embargo, los efectos fueron heterogéneos: la proximidad social incrementó notablemente la persuasión, mientras que la proximidad espacial produjo solo un impacto modesto.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo orienta a organizaciones sin fines de lucro a diseñar campañas que enfatizen la cercanía social del beneficiario, aumentando la efectividad de la recaudación y la ayuda voluntaria.
stories.paperTitle: Near, Far, Wherever You Are: Understanding Distance Effects in Prosocial Cause Appeals
stories.originalAbstract: Recent federal cuts have intensified pressure on nonprofit organizations, particularly those supporting vulnerable communities. As government support declines, nonprofits are increasingly dependent on individual prosocial contributions not only in terms of donations, but also more generally in terms of helping, to sustain their programs. Yet, motivating individual support for psychologically distant causes—those perceived as unrelated to one's immediate context—remains a persistent challenge. Despite over 17 years of research on prosocial behavior, it is unclear how psychological distance shapes responses to cause-related appeals. This meta-analysis synthesizes 235 effect sizes from 132 empirical studies to examine how psychological distance influences prosocial responses to cause-related appeals. Overall, the authors find no significant difference in prosocial responses between psychologically distant and proximal appeals. The results reveal distinct effects across dimensions of psychological distance. While spatially proximal causes yield only a modest impact, socially proximal causes are notably more persuasive. Crucially, proximal causes interact with the nature of the prosocial outcome: Proximal appeals are more effective when they spotlight a single individual or request monetary donations. These findings provide insights for nonprofits seeking to optimize individual prosocial engagement amid widening economic and social disparities.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo afecta la comparación online a tu bienestar psicológico?
stories.headline: La comparación social en línea se asocia a peor salud mental y burnout
stories.finding: Un meta‑análisis de cinco estudios encontró vínculos fuertes entre la comparación social online y peor salud mental, incluyendo depresión, ansiedad, insatisfacción corporal y menor satisfacción vital, sobre todo en comparaciones ascendentes. Entrevistas a influencers y usuarios mostraron ciclos de ansiedad, desgaste (burnout) e identidad fragmentada, intensificados por métricas de rendimiento.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo alerta a profesionales de salud mental sobre la necesidad de abordar la comparación digital y sus métricas en la prevención de trastornos emocionales y burnout, ofreciendo una base para intervenciones de regulación de uso y resiliencia en entornos online.
stories.paperTitle: The cost of comparison: a mixed methods approach to understanding the impact of online social comparison on psychological well-being
stories.journal: London School of Economics and Political Science Research Online (London School of Economics and Political Science)
stories.originalAbstract: This monograph examines the psychological effects of online social comparison among general users and influencers, based on five studies. A meta-analysis shows strong links between comparison and poorer mental health, including depression, anxiety, body dissatisfaction, and lower life satisfaction, especially through upward comparisons. A two-part survey describes users’ struggles with screen time, usage conflicts, and posting anxiety. Interviews with hybrid influencers (famous offline) and primary influencers (famous online) reveal that prior fame offers little protection against comparison pressures; both groups experience cycles of anxiety, identity strain, burnout, and dependence on virality metrics, with differences in how they manage offline and online identities. These findings extend social comparison theory by demonstrating that online comparison follows nonlinear trajectories, moderated by performance metrics, with perfectionism amplifying volatility during these phases; however, the generalizability of these findings is limited by Western sampling and survivorship bias.

stories.hook: ¿Qué factores empeoran el duelo tras un homicidio?
stories.headline: Revisión sistemática revela factores clave del duelo tras homicidio
stories.finding: El análisis de 35 estudios sobre personas que han sufrido el homicidio de un ser querido identificó los factores más frecuentes asociados a su salud mental. Los factores se agruparon en tres categorías predominantes: el sistema de justicia penal (18 estudios), factores sociales (17 estudios) y estrategias de afrontamiento (13 estudios).
stories.takeaway: Comprender estos dominios permite a clínicos diseñar intervenciones dirigidas y a políticas mejorar la respuesta judicial, reduciendo el sufrimiento y favoreciendo la resiliencia de los sobrevivientes.
stories.paperTitle: Mental Health of Homicidally Bereaved Individuals: A Systematic Review of Post-Homicide Factors
stories.journal: OMEGA - Journal of Death and Dying
stories.originalAbstract: Experiencing the homicide of a loved one has a substantial impact on the mental health of family members and friends who must survive their loved one’s tragic death. This systematic review aims to synthesize the current findings on post-homicide factors and identify the factors most frequently related to the mental health of homicidally bereaved individuals (HBI). Four databases were searched (PsycINFO, SCOPUS, Sociological Abstract, PubMed). The selection of studies was based on a peer review process conducted by two independent researchers to ensure interrater reliability. The articles were screened to ensure the presence of homicidally bereaved adults, resulting in a total of 35 eligible papers to be considered in the current review. Factors were organized into categories, with the criminal justice system-related factors ( n = 18), social factors ( n = 17), and coping factors ( n = 13) being the most prevalent. This review identifies clinical avenues for preventing distress and fostering the well-being of HBI.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la estimulación cerebral no invasiva mejorar la atención en TDAH?
stories.headline: La estimulación transcraneal directa reduce déficits cognitivos en TDAH
stories.finding: El meta‑análisis de ensayos controlados aleatorios mostró que la estimulación transcraneal de corriente directa (tDCS) produce mejoras significativas en el control inhibitorio, la memoria de trabajo y la inatención respecto a la condición sham. En contraste, la estimulación magnética transcraneal repetitiva (rTMS) no evidenció beneficios terapéuticos.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo respalda el uso de tDCS como intervención complementaria para mitigar déficits ejecutivos en niños y adultos con TDAH, orientando decisiones clínicas y futuras investigaciones hacia protocolos de estimulación seguros y eficaces.
stories.paperTitle: Noninvasive Brain Stimulation for Improving Cognitive Deficits and Clinical Symptoms in Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
stories.originalAbstract: Objective: Noninvasive brain stimulation (NIBS) is a promising complementary treatment for attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). However, its efficacy varies due to diverse participant profiles and methodologies. This meta-analysis, registered with PROSPERO (CRD42023457269), seeks to assess NIBS efficacy in improving cognitive deficits and clinical symptoms in individuals with ADHD. Methods: We systematically searched five databases (October 2024) for randomized controlled trials focusing on cognitive functions and clinical symptoms in individuals meeting the DSM/ICD criteria for ADHD. A meta-analytical synthesis was conducted using RevMan 5.4.1. Results: Meta-analyses found significant improvement in inhibitory control, working memory, and inattention in active transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) groups compared with sham groups. Conversely, repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) did not demonstrate significant therapeutic benefits for ADHD symptoms. Additionally, four transcranial random noise stimulation (tRNS) and three transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) studies demonstrated promising improvements in executive functions and the alleviation of ADHD symptoms. Conclusions: The findings from this meta-analysis highlight NIBS as a promising adjunctive therapy for managing ADHD, advancing both theoretical knowledge and practical treatment options in this field.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo entrevistar a niños sin sesgos ni artefactos?
stories.headline: Recomendaciones basadas en evidencia para entrevistas forenses infantiles sin uso de muñecos
stories.finding: El documento propone que los entrevistadores utilicen protocolos de entrevista basados en evidencia, realicen pruebas de hipótesis y graben las sesiones. Además, enfatiza la preparación previa, la creación de rapport y la consideración cultural, y desaconseja el uso de muñecos, diagramas corporales o la interpretación de dibujos.
stories.takeaway: Estas recomendaciones mejoran la fiabilidad de los testimonios infantiles y reducen el riesgo de contaminación, lo que protege a los menores y fortalece la investigación de abusos.
stories.paperTitle: White paper on forensic child interviewing: research-based recommendations by the European Association of Psychology and Law
stories.originalAbstract: This white paper consists of evidence-based recommendations for conducting forensic interviews with children. The recommendations are jointly drafted by researchers in child interviewing active within the European Association of Psychology and Law and are focused on cases in which children are interviewed in forensic settings, in particular within investigations of child sexual and/or physical abuse. One particular purpose of the white paper is to assist the growing Barnahus movement in Europe to develop investigative practise that is science-based. The key recommendations entail the expertise required by interviewers, how interviews should be conducted and how interviewers should be trained. Interviewers are advised to use evidence-based interview protocols, engage in hypothesis-testing and record their interviews. The need to prepare the interview well and making efforts to familiarise the child with the interview situation and create rapport as well as acknowledging cultural factors and the possible need for interpretation is underscored, and a recommendation is made not to rely on dolls, body diagrams and the interpretation of drawings in the interviews. Online child interviewing is noted as showing promising results, but more research is warranted before conclusive recommendations can be made. Interviewers should receive specialised training and continuous feedback on their interviews.
stories.abstract: This white paper consists of evidence-based recommendations for conducting forensic interviews with children. The recommendations are jointly drafted by researchers in child interviewing active within the European Association of Psychology and Law and are focused on cases in which children are interviewed in forensic settings, in particular within investigations of child sexual and/or physical abuse. One particular purpose of the white paper is to assist the growing Barnahus movement in Europe to develop investigative practise that is science-based. The key recommendations entail the expertise required by interviewers, how interviews should be conducted and how interviewers should be trained. Interviewers are advised to use evidence-based interview protocols, engage in hypothesis-testing and record their interviews. The need to prepare the interview well and making efforts to familiarise the child with the interview situation and create rapport as well as acknowledging cultural factors and the possible need for interpretation is underscored, and a recommendation is made not to rely on dolls, body diagrams and the interpretation of drawings in the interviews. Online child interviewing is noted as showing promising results, but more research is warranted before conclusive recommendations can be made. Interviewers should receive specialised training and continuous feedback on their interviews.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el microbioma moldear el desarrollo cerebral infantil?
stories.headline: Disbiosis del microbioma intestinal vinculada a trastornos neurodesarrollamentales
stories.finding: El microbioma intestinal se establece durante los primeros años de vida y su composición puede alterarse por factores como el modo de parto, la lactancia, antibióticos, químicos y estrés materno. La disbiosis durante esta ventana crítica se asocia con alteraciones en la comunicación bidireccional microbioma‑cerebro y con mayor riesgo de trastornos neurodesarrollamentales, entre ellos autismo, TDAH, síndrome de Tourette, parálisis cerebral y trastornos genéticos.
stories.takeaway: Comprender esta relación permite diseñar estrategias preventivas y terapéuticas—como probióticos, dietas específicas o reducción de exposiciones adversas—para favorecer un desarrollo cerebral saludable y disminuir la incidencia o severidad de los trastornos neurodesarrollamentales.
stories.paperTitle: Neurodevelopmental Disorders Associated with Gut Microbiome Dysbiosis in Children
stories.originalAbstract: The formation of the human gut microbiome initiates in utero, and its maturation is established during the first 2-3 years of life. Numerous factors alter the composition of the gut microbiome and its functions, including mode of delivery, early onset of breastfeeding, exposure to antibiotics and chemicals, and maternal stress, among others. The gut microbiome-brain axis refers to the interconnection of biological networks that allow bidirectional communication between the gut microbiome and the brain, involving the nervous, endocrine, and immune systems. Evidence suggests that the gut microbiome and its metabolic byproducts are actively implicated in the regulation of the early brain development. Any disturbance during this stage may adversely affect brain functions, resulting in a variety of neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs). In the present study, we reviewed recent evidence regarding the impact of the gut microbiome on early brain development, alongside its correlation with significant NDDs, such as autism spectrum disorder, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder, Tourette syndrome, cerebral palsy, fetal alcohol spectrum disorders, and genetic NDDs (Rett, Down, Angelman, and Turner syndromes). Understanding changes in the gut microbiome in NDDs may provide new chances for their treatment in the future.
